description: This PHP source file defines the SaveCustomFieldController class, which manages the rendering of a custom field save/edit component in the OrangeHRM system, including fetching services, handling request attributes, and setting up Vue components with internationalized labels.

classes.name: SaveCustomFieldController
classes.description: Controller class for saving and editing custom fields, extending AbstractVueController, utilizing services and traits to prepare Vue components with necessary data.

methods.name: getCustomFieldService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of CustomFieldService.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with properties based on the request, including custom field ID, usage status, and lists for screen and field types with internationalized labels.
